name: Effective Java
description: Best practices for Java platform programming including concurrency
column8: and annotations. A must-read for senior Java engineers.
column9: 面向 Java 平台编程的最佳实践书籍，覆盖并发、泛型、枚举与注解等主题，是 Java 资深工程师的必读经典。

name: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
name_zh: 数据密集型应用系统设计
column11: 讲解可靠、可扩展与可维护系统背后的大思路，深入剖析数据库、消息队列、流处理与分布式系统。

name: Clean Code
description: A handbook of agile software craftsmanship. Teaches how to write code that is readable
column8: 敏捷软件工艺手册，讲解如何编写可读、可复用、易重构的代码。

name: Domain-Driven Design
description: Distills the core ideas of DDD: bounded contexts
column8: and ubiquitous language. Recommended for backend architects.
column9: 提炼 DDD 核心思想：限界上下文、聚合、领域事件与统一语言，推荐后端架构师阅读。

name: Sprint
description_zh: Slack and small startups validate ideas through five-day sprints. A practical guide to rapid product validation.
column7: 介绍 Google、Slack 等团队如何用五天冲刺验证想法，是产品快速验证的实战指南。

name: Atomic Habits
description: A proven framework for improving every day by stacking tiny habits. James Clear's worldwide bestseller.
description_zh: 通过叠加微小习惯来持续改善的成熟框架，詹姆斯·克利尔的全球畅销书。
